{{Quote|Haven't gotten to come to a briefing like this since my time in the four-thirty-ninth bomber wing.|Galena Rans|<ref name="Onslaught" />}}
The '''four-thirty-ninth bomber wing''' served the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. Before becoming [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Galena Rans]] served in the four-thirty-ninth [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]]<ref name="Onslaught" /> as a [[Commander/Legends|commander]].<ref name="Codex" /> In [[3627 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.0}}</ref> Rans mentioned that since her [[Time/Legends|time]] in the four-thirty-ninth bomber wing, she had not attended a military briefing like the one given by [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] [[Numinn]] before the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Battle of the Meridian Complex|attack]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] [[Meridian Complex]].<ref name="Onslaught" />

==Behind the scenes==
The four-thirty-ninth bomber wing was mentioned in the [[2019]] [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] expansion of [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Onslaught" />
